findings.title: [P1] Pass the branch as an argv element
findings.body: When `branch` contains shell syntax—for example, a valid Git ref containing `;`—`exec` parses it as part of the command and executes the trailing text with the application's privileges. The previous `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` passed the branch literally; retain argument-based execution rather than interpolating this value into a shell command.
